content: Jane do you have a pen pal?
Yes, I do. Her name is Alice.
In England, but we don't often write to each other because neither of us has much time, we both have a lot of work to do.
Do you know what your pen pals hobbies are?
Yes, she enjoys listening to music. Among school subjects she likes math best.
Are you going to write to her soon?
I'm not sure. I'm pretty busy but I'll write to her when I have time.
